name: Margin Call Result 2
definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts for the variation margin and optionaly the segregated independent amount.

VariationMarginResult.name: Variation Margin Result
VariationMarginResult.definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts for the variation margin amount only.

SegregatedIndependentAmount.name: Segregated Independent Amount
SegregatedIndependentAmount.definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts for the segregated independent amount.
